purpose: Stage and independently review only the inert trusted-path and regular-file binding primitives for future Local Mistral conversion evidence verification.
requiredInvariants: This PR stages only inert path/file primitives; it does not parse conversion-report JSON, authorize model/server identity, invoke a model, publish evidence or activate a workflow.
The conversion root is reconstructed only from exact lower-hex main SHA plus exact positive integer run id and attempt; the authority root must exactly equal the reconstructed literal.

The absolute conversion root is opened component-by-component from filesystem root using directory FDs with O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC; authority path text is never used as an os.open path.

Authority relative-path strings are used only for exact equality against fixed path-part tuples; each fixed parent component is opened relative to an already anchored directory FD and held open through final-file binding.
The final bound file opens by name relative to the anchored parent directory FD with O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC and must be a regular file.

Exact-size hashing requires a strict lower-hex expected SHA-256, counts exactly expected bytes, compares fd device, inode, size, mtime_ns and ctime_ns before and after reading, and returns only after the computed SHA-256 exactly equals authority; truncation, extension, replacement, mutation or digest mismatch fails closed.
No review, attestation, provider status, exact-head verifier authority, product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production-routing behavior is activated.
Local Qwen is the independent reviewer because this changes future Local Mistral authority only.
REG.RU remains production authority and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
